headline: Argentine bonds rise and country risk drops amid global market gains
summary: Argentine dollar-denominated public bonds rebounded 0.5% and the JP Morgan country risk indicator fell to 827 points, buoyed by positive momentum in international stock markets after US legislative elections.
why: Argentine sovereign debt performance is sensitive to international risk appetite and domestic economic policy expectations.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: International market rallies supported gains in Argentine dollar bonds and lower country risk.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Spillover from Wall Street rallies following the US midterms improved risk appetite for emerging market debt.
